QUOTE: `$ENTROPIC_LIB`, then `$ENTROPIC_HOME` (nested and flat layouts), then `~/.entropic/...`, then `ctypes.util.find_library`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer lists the env overrides, the user directory and `find_library`, but it applies the nested and flat layouts only to `$ENTROPIC_HOME`. The item requires two layouts per root. It also never names the system library cache.
